issues.legal_issue: A dispute concerning alleged irregularities by a former managing committee in purchasing building materials for a cooperative society’s construction project falls within the category of disputes referable to arbitration.
material_facts: A cooperative society’s new managing committee complained of alleged irregularities by the previous managing committee in purchasing building materials for the society’s construction project.
The appellant had served as president of the previous managing committee.
The Registrar referred the dispute to arbitration.
issues.conclusion: The dispute touched the management of the cooperative society and was properly referred to arbitration; the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 60(1)(c) of the Delhi Co-operative Societies Act, 1972, a dispute touching the constitution, management or business of a cooperative society between the society or its committee and a past committee or past officer is referable to arbitration. Section 60(2) is illustrative, not exhaustive. The Court followed Pentakota Srirakulu v. The Cooperative Marketing Society Ltd. and disapproved Chander Nagar Cooperative House Building Society Ltd. v. Ashok Ohri. Section 59, concerning surcharge, did not displace the application of Section 60 to this dispute.

rule.if: cooperative_society_arbitration_referral and society_against_past_committee_or_officer and dispute_touches_management and not employee_disciplinary_dispute

predicates.cooperative_society_arbitration_referral: A registrar referred a dispute involving a cooperative society to arbitration.
predicates.society_against_past_committee_or_office: The dispute is between a cooperative society or its committee and a past committee or past officer of that society.
predicates.dispute_touches_management: The dispute concerns conduct relating to the management of the cooperative society.
predicates.employee_disciplinary_dispute: The dispute concerns disciplinary action by the society or its committee against a paid employee of the society.

issues.definition: When a registrar refers a cooperative-society dispute against a past committee or officer that concerns management, and it is not an employee disciplinary dispute, the dispute is referable to arbitration.
